visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing an olive green outdoor jacket stands under a large metal shed structure next to a gray stone wall. He uses his right hand to point at a specific bolt on a metal pillar while the camera remains steady, capturing his profile and the surrounding concrete camping environment. (2) The man crouches down on the concrete floor to demonstrate a screw-in metal ring mechanism. He holds the small circular metal object in his hand, showing it clearly to the camera before pointing to a threaded hole embedded in the base of the shed's support pillar. (3) A woman with long brown hair wearing a tan puffer vest stands in the center of the large, open camping shed. She gestures broadly with both arms toward the high corrugated metal ceiling and the misty mountain background, conveying the scale and height of the sheltered space. (4) The woman stands at a stainless steel kitchen station featuring multiple sinks. She turns on a modern faucet and pulls out the retractable spray head to demonstrate its functionality, with clear water splashing into the basin under bright, overcast natural daylight. (5) A series of quick cuts shows two large silver refrigerators and a digital water dispenser located within the shed area. The woman then walks through a clean, tiled bathroom area, pointing out hair dryers on the wall and stainless steel urinals in a semi-outdoor restroom section.
